LESSON: CALL TO PROPHETHOOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.1: Call to Prophethood

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Call to Prophethood
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the teachings of the first five verses revealed to Prophet (S.A.W)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the Prophet’s incidence at cave Hira with Angel Jibril (A.S.)
2. identify the earliest converts to Islam
3. explain the role played by the earliest converts to Islam
4. appreciate the role played by earliest converts to the development of Islam

SECTION: WORK TO DO

2. What role did the earliest converts play in the Prophet’s mission?
